## Checklist for blog posts

<!-- Skip if not a blog post -->

- [ ] Filename follows `your-slug-here.mdx` and is placed in `src/content/blog/`
- [ ] Frontmatter is complete (title, description, pubDate, author, tags)
- [ ] I added myself to `src/content/authors/` if this is my first post
- [ ] Code blocks have language tags for syntax highlighting
- [ ] Images / diagrams are placed alongside the post and imported (not hotlinked)
- [ ] Any cited papers, benchmarks, or repos are linked
- [ ] `pnpm build` runs cleanly with no errors
- [ ] I've reviewed the preview deploy and it renders correctly
- [ ] I agree to publish this content under CC-BY-4.0 (or have specified an alternative license in the frontmatter)

## Checklist for site changes

<!-- Skip if not a site change -->

- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `pnpm dev` runs without errors
- [ ] Changes are accessible (keyboard nav, contrast, alt text, semantic HTML)
- [ ] Changes work on mobile
- [ ] No regression in Lighthouse scores on touched pages
